about_the_game:
Curse of the Lineage is an isometric puzzle roguelike that fuses strategic dungeon-crawling with intricate, evolving tiles. Each run takes you deeper into a decaying ancestral ground, where every corner hides a secret and every choice has a cost.

UNCOVER YOUR LEGACY

Step into the remnants of your bloodline’s estate, long consumed by corruption and madness. Traverse shifting tiles filled with spirits, powerful charms and spiritual powers. Each tile explored peels back another layer of your family’s tragic history.

FACE THE RESTLESS

As the fog recedes, so too does the calm. Ghosts emerge from the shadows, each drawn to the echo of your lineage. Outsmart, outmaneuver, and survive their pursuit while managing limited space. Take advantage of the path you explored to outsmart the souls.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH

Between each descent, chart your route across a boundless map choosing your next encounter from shrines , lotus resting places , or unique challenges. Every choice shapes your run, your rewards, and your unraveling fate.

A CURSED LEGACY

Piece by piece, uncover the story of a family consumed by its own misdeeds. Every run brings new relics, new routes, and new revelations waiting beneath the fog.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB VRAM / DirectX 10+ support
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
